strings.zh: 您好,这里是{NEWLINE}环球贸易站,{CLEAR}简称ＧＴＳ！{SCROLL}您可以在这里{NEWLINE}通过ＷｉーＦｉ链接{SCROLL}与全世界的玩家交换精灵。{SCROLL}请问您想使用{NEWLINE}环球精灵交换系统吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Welcome! This is the Global Trade{NEWLINE}Station, or GTS for short.{SCROLL}We enable the trading of Pokémon with{NEWLINE}people worldwide over Nintendo WFC.{SCROLL}Would you like to do a global{NEWLINE}Pokémon trade? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 您好！{NEWLINE}欢迎来到ＧＴＳ！{SCROLL}您想通过ＷｉーＦｉ链接{NEWLINE}与其他玩家进行{CLEAR}环球精灵交换吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hello!{NEWLINE}Welcome to the GTS!{SCROLL}Would you like to do{NEWLINE}a global Pokémon trade over{CLEAR}Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0600/1; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 在ＧＴＳ中,您可以通过{NEWLINE}存放精灵和搜寻精灵{SCROLL}这两种方法进行精灵的交换。{SCROLL}您想听详细说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You may trade Pokémon one of two{NEWLINE}ways at the GTS.{SCROLL}You may offer a Pokémon for trade,{NEWLINE}or search among offered Pokémon.{SCROLL}Should I describe things in greater{NEWLINE}detail? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 您可以在这寄存{NEWLINE}想要拿去交换的精灵,{SCROLL}之后您可以去寻找{NEWLINE}自己想要的精灵。{SCROLL}在存放期间,{NEWLINE}如果发现了条件相一致的精灵,{CLEAR}就可以进行交换。{SCROLL}您还需要听取{NEWLINE}其他的详细说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You will be asked to put up the{NEWLINE}Pokémon you are offering to trade.{SCROLL}At that time, you will be asked what{NEWLINE}Pokémon you would like in return.{SCROLL}If another player offers your desired{NEWLINE}Pokémon in return for your offered{CLEAR}Pokémon, the trade will go through.{SCROLL}Should I explain anything else? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我们也可以从{NEWLINE}寄存的众多精灵中{SCROLL}挑选出您所需要的精灵。{SCROLL}当你要交换该精灵时,{NEWLINE}需要将对方需要的精灵{CLEAR}寄存给我们。{SCROLL}您还需要听取{NEWLINE}其他的详细说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You can also search the many Pokémon{NEWLINE}deposited here for the one you want.{SCROLL}To trade for it, you need to deposit the{NEWLINE}Pokémon that the other Trainer wants{CLEAR}with us.{SCROLL}Should I explain anything else? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0600/4 | RV038: addition: US added explanation the zh lacks (D-1932 scope)

strings.zh: 请问您想使用{NEWLINE}环球精灵交换系统吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Would you like to make a global{NEWLINE}Pokémon trade? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 欢迎下次再来。
strings.en: Please do visit again.

strings.zh: 欢迎使用ＧＴＳ！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the GTS!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 很抱歉,{SCROLL}您手头以及箱子中的{NEWLINE}精灵都已经满了,{SCROLL}您需要将手头或者箱子{NEWLINE}清理出空位{CLEAR}才能使用ＧＴＳ。
strings.en: I’m sorry...{SCROLL}Your party and your PC Boxes{NEWLINE}are both full of Pokémon.{SCROLL}Please free up some space in your{NEWLINE}party or a Box before using the GTS.

strings.zh: 很抱歉,{NEWLINE}如果您手头{SCROLL}没有两只以上的精灵,{NEWLINE}那您将无法使用ＧＴＳ。{SCROLL}请您带上精灵再来。
strings.en: I’m sorry, but if you don’t have{NEWLINE}at least two Pokémon with you,{SCROLL}you won’t be able to use the GTS.{SCROLL}Please come back with more Pokémon.

strings.zh: 地球怎么才这么点啊？{SCROLL}什么！你说这只是一个模型？{NEWLINE}真正的地球{CLEAR}有它的成千上万倍大？{SCROLL}我滴这个乖乖龙地咚！
strings.en: Why is the Earth so tiny? What?! You’re{NEWLINE}saying this is just a model?{SCROLL}The real Earth is thousands and{NEWLINE}thousands of times bigger than this?{SCROLL}Whoaaaaaaa!
strings.notes: US 0600/10 | RV038: meaning: 成千上万 not millions; zh asks why the Earth is so small (D-1932)

strings.zh: 这个地球仪上{NEWLINE}还能记录下{SCROLL}曾与你交换过的{NEWLINE}玩家的地址！
strings.en: This globe can also record the locations{NEWLINE}of the players you’ve traded with!

strings.zh: 我们把精灵寄存在这,{NEWLINE}然后回去睡上一觉,{CLEAR}等你醒来的时候,{CLEAR}发现交换已经完成了！
strings.en: We leave our Pokémon here, go home for{NEWLINE}a good sleep, and when we wake up, the{CLEAR}trade is already done!
strings.notes: US 0600/12 | RV038: meaning: zh: wake to a finished trade, not a maybe (D-1932)

strings.zh: 这里的设备太先进了,{NEWLINE}我们可以通过它{CLEAR}与住在{CLEAR}世界另一头的{CLEAR}口袋爱好者{SCROLL}方便地进行交换！
strings.en: Using the equipment here, you can easily{NEWLINE}trade Pokémon with other Pokémon fans{CLEAR}on the other side of the world!{SCROLL}That’s incredible!

strings.zh: 这个地球仪上{NEWLINE}可是能够记录下{CLEAR}你所住的地方哦！{SCROLL}记录之后,{NEWLINE}与你交换过的玩家{CLEAR}也能知道你住在什么地方。
strings.en: This globe can record where you live!{NEWLINE}Once it’s recorded, the players you’ve{CLEAR}traded with can see where you live too.
strings.notes: US 0600/14 | RV038: meaning: only traded players see your location (D-1932)

strings.zh: 是ＷｉーＦｉ链接{NEWLINE}让我从此过上了{CLEAR}能与其他玩家{CLEAR}便捷交换的日子。
strings.en: Thanks to Nintendo WFC, I can now trade{NEWLINE}with other players easily!
strings.notes: US 0600/15 | RV038: addition: US 'even I' not in zh (D-1932)

strings.zh: 你看着,这礼拜{SCROLL}我一定要打进排行榜前四……{NEWLINE}那才叫真见鬼了。
strings.en: Watch me. This week I’m definitely{NEWLINE}making the top four of the rankings...{SCROLL}Yeah, and pigs will fly.

strings.zh: 全球接点共分三层！{SCROLL}你可以通过传送点{NEWLINE}方便地在三个楼层间来回！{SCROLL}蓝色前往１Ｆ　ＧＴＳ排行榜！{SCROLL}绿色前往２Ｆ　盒子速照和{NEWLINE}盛装速照！{SCROLL}粉色前往３Ｆ　对战录像！
strings.en: The Global Terminal has three floors!{SCROLL}You can use the warp panels to{NEWLINE}get between the floors easily!{SCROLL}Blue goes to the GTS and{NEWLINE}Trainer Rankings on 1F!{SCROLL}Green goes to Box Data{NEWLINE}and Dress-Up Data on 2F!{SCROLL}Pink goes to the Battle Videos on 3F!
Your favorite is {VAR:0100:0},{NEWLINE}isn’t it? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.en: Your favorite is that Egg,{NEWLINE}isn’t it? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你看,我没说错吧！{NEWLINE}我想的一点都没错！
strings.en: See? I was right!{NEWLINE}I knew it all along!

strings.zh: 你的宝贝不是{VAR:0100:0}吗？
strings.en: ...Oh? Your favorite really is{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:0}, isn’t it?

strings.zh: 你的宝贝不是蛋吗？
strings.en: ...Oh? Your favorite really is that Egg,{NEWLINE}isn’t it?

strings.zh: 我想知道所有人的宝贝精灵！
strings.en: I want to know everyone’s{NEWLINE}favorite Pokémon!

strings.zh: 你在对别人{SCROLL}介绍自己的时候会说哪些呢？{NEWLINE}快点告诉我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: What do you say when you introduce{NEWLINE}yourself to others? Tell me, quick! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0600/24 | RV038: meaning: zh asks how you introduce yourself; US 'yo' voice not in zh (D-1932)

strings.zh: 我已经对你有所了解了！{SCROLL}如果你想换一句说辞,{NEWLINE}来找我就行。
strings.en: I feel like I know you now!{SCROLL}If you want to change what you say,{NEWLINE}just come see me.
strings.notes: US 0600/25 | RV038: addition: US 'yo' tic not in zh

strings.zh: 什么！{NEWLINE}你就没什么话想说吗？{SCROLL}如果你想换一句说辞,{NEWLINE}来找我就行。
strings.en: What?! You don’t have anything you{NEWLINE}want to say?{SCROLL}If you want to change what you say,{NEWLINE}just come see me.
strings.notes: US 0600/26 | RV038: addition: US 'yo' tic not in zh

strings.zh: 全球接点中{NEWLINE}设置了各式各样的机器。{SCROLL}这些机器可以通过战斗记录器{NEWLINE}进行通信！{SCROLL}首先,请挑选一个{NEWLINE}你喜欢的机器。
strings.en: The Global Terminal has{NEWLINE}all sorts of machines.{SCROLL}You can connect to them{NEWLINE}with your Vs. Recorder!{SCROLL}First, pick whichever machine you like.

strings.zh: 欢迎来到全球接点！{SCROLL}你可以在这里{NEWLINE}查看全世界训练师的记录{SCROLL}并且还能与全世界玩家交换精灵！
strings.en: Welcome to the Global Terminal!{SCROLL}Here you can view the records of{NEWLINE}Trainers from all over the world,{SCROLL}and trade Pokémon with{NEWLINE}players around the globe!

strings.en: Connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi{NEWLINE}Connection for Trainer Rankings? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 训练师排行榜{NEWLINE}会将全世界的训练师{CLEAR}划分为数个小队,{CLEAR}这些小队将相互战斗,{CLEAR}争夺排名。{SCROLL}您的成绩将{NEWLINE}自动发送到您所在的队伍。{SCROLL}请注意一点！{SCROLL}如果你反复参加{NEWLINE}同一个排行榜,{SCROLL}则发送的成绩会覆盖掉{CLEAR}上一次的成绩。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Trainer Rankings split Trainers all over{NEWLINE}the world into several teams, and the{CLEAR}teams battle it out for the top spot.{SCROLL}Your results are sent to{NEWLINE}your team automatically.{SCROLL}Please note!{SCROLL}If you enter the same{NEWLINE}ranking more than once,{SCROLL}your new results will{NEWLINE}overwrite the previous ones.{SCROLL}
